title: MB Expert LLC Services
intro: Complete diagnostics, mobile locksmith work, electrical programming, pre-purchase audits, maintenance support, and brake systems service for modern vehicles.

categories.title: In-Depth Computer Diagnostics
categories.description: Electronic and module-level diagnosis for modern vehicles that need more than a basic scan.

services.title: Full System Scan
services.description: A complete vehicle-wide scan to quickly uncover stored faults, communication issues, and hidden module problems.

services.title: Safety Systems Diagnostics (Airbag/SRS)
services.description: Targeted safety-system diagnosis for airbag, SRS, and warning lamp concerns that need accurate electronic tracing.

services.title: Precision Troubleshooting
services.description: Step-by-step fault isolation for hard-to-find electrical and drivability issues that do not show up in a basic scan.

services.title: Engine Performance Diagnostics
services.description: Focused analysis of engine behavior, misfires, throttle response, and sensor output to find the real cause.

services.title: Emissions & EVAP Services
services.description: Diagnosis and repair support for emissions faults, EVAP leaks, and related compliance issues.

categories.title: Auto Electrical & Programming (Flashing)
categories.description: Electrical repair and software-level programming for drivability, starting and charging issues.

services.title: Control Module Programming (ECU)
services.description: Programming and flashing support for control modules when software updates or recalibration are needed.

services.title: Complex Electrical Repair
services.description: Troubleshooting and repair for wiring faults, relays, power distribution, and intermittent electrical failures.

services.title: Starting & Charging Systems
services.description: Diagnosis of battery, alternator, starter, and charging circuit problems that keep the vehicle from starting reliably.

services.title: Hybrids & Electric Vehicles (EV)
services.description: Support for modern electrified platforms that require careful technical work and specialized diagnostic workflows.

categories.title: Mobile Locksmith Services
categories.description: On-site access and key services when the vehicle is locked, the key is missing, or the immobilizer needs attention.

services.title: Emergency Car Lockout
services.description: Fast on-site vehicle entry help for lockout situations without unnecessary towing or dealership delays.

services.title: Key Cutting & Programming
services.description: Key cutting, transponder setup, and programming support for replacement, spare, or lost keys.

services.title: Immobilizer Reset
services.description: Immobilizer support for cases where the vehicle recognizes the key improperly or will not authorize start-up.

categories.title: Pre-Purchase Electronic & Technical Audit
categories.description: A technical review that helps buyers understand the condition of the electronics before purchase.

services.title: Comprehensive Module Scan
services.description: A buyer-focused scan that checks for hidden faults, stored codes, and module communication issues before you purchase.

services.title: Electrical & Engine Integrity Check
services.description: A deeper technical check that looks at engine behavior, electrical health, and signs of expensive underlying issues.

categories.title: Additional Maintenance & Sensor Services
categories.description: Support for common maintenance items and sensor-related failures that affect reliability.

services.title: Cooling System Maintenance
services.description: Maintenance and repair support for cooling components that protect engine performance and temperature control.

services.title: TPMS Sensor Services
services.description: Tire pressure monitoring sensor support for warnings, sensor replacement, and system relearning.

services.title: Wearable Parts Replacement
services.description: Replacement of common wear items that affect safe operation, drivability, and long-term reliability.

categories.title: Brake Systems Services
categories.description: Brake-related diagnostics and repair for safety-critical stopping performance.

services.title: Brake System Diagnostics
services.description: Diagnostic work to isolate noises, pull, vibration, warning lights, or inconsistent brake pedal behavior.

services.title: Disc & Drum Brake Service
services.description: Service and repair for disc and drum brake components, including wear-related issues and braking feel.

services.title: Hydraulic System Repair
services.description: Diagnosis and repair of hydraulic braking problems involving calipers, lines, fluid pressure, or pedal feel.

services.title: Wheel Hub & Bearing Replacement
services.description: Replacement of worn hubs and bearings that create noise, looseness, or unsafe drivability.

services.title: ABS (Antilock Brake System) Diagnostics & Repair
services.description: ABS fault diagnosis and repair for warning lights, wheel speed sensor faults, and braking stability issues.

services.title: Parking Brake Service
services.description: Parking brake adjustment and service for mechanical or electronic systems that need proper hold and release.

services.title: Brake Fluid Flush & Bleeding
services.description: Brake fluid replacement and bleeding to maintain hydraulic performance and pedal consistency.
